output_list.reason: The 'transferFrom' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function does not check if the subtraction of the balance of the sender will result in a negative value, allowing attackers to exploit this vulnerability to increase balance of arbitrary accounts.

The 'batchTransfer' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function does not check if the multiplication of the total amount to be transferred and the number of recipients will overflow, allowing attackers to exploit this vulnerability to increase balance of arbitrary accounts.
